## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is characterized by his distinctly goggle-like eyes, an appearance that is especially pronounced when viewed in the moonlight. Additionally, his hands are known to feel consistently cold and fishy to the touch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Farewell P23](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane carries himself with a notable sense of importance, particularly during his time as a college sophomore. Driven by political ambitions, he aspires to enter politics and ultimately serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was a peer of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who had engaged in literary efforts in his youth and was madly infatuated with [Anne](../character/anne.md) when she was seventeen. He escorted [Anne](../character/anne.md) home from an A. V. I. S. farewell party before traveling alongside her and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) to begin their studies at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). During their freshman year, Charlie joined [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) on an afternoon walk through the park and harbor, where they discovered Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), +334 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends who attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) together. Despite their friendship, a mild rivalry exists between them regarding the affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). On one occasion, [Anne](../character/anne.md) even chose to walk home with Charlie from an A.V.I.S. farewell party specifically to spite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

- Rival of — rivals in the good graces of a certain damsel (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
- Friend of — longtime friends (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P11](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0011)</sub>

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--charlie-sloane.md)

Charlie harbors romantic feelings for [Anne](../character/anne.md) and eventually proposed marriage to her, though she rejected his offer. He spent time with her during their school years and later accompanied her on outings alongside mutual friends at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne.md) occasionally used Charlie's company to provoke [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), but ultimately did not return his romantic interest.

- Romantically involved with — proposed marriage to her and was rejected (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>
